title: Hysteresis in Atomic Josephson Junctions
summary: Hysteresis and retrapping are hallmarks of underdamped Josephson dynamics, yet they have remained elusive in atomic Josephson junctions. Here, we introduce a velocity-sweep protocol to demonstrate these phenomena in the underdamped regime of an atomic Josephson junction. Specifically, using classical-field simulations of a two-dimensional bosonic superfluid, we show hysteresis in the velocity-imbalance characteristics and determine the retrapping current.
